title: Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 6,579.49 up 25.13 points
text:
Shutterstock photo Thursday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 6,579.49. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.34 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 1.03 to 1 ratio. There were 1596 advancers and 1545 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 1 stocks reached a 52 week high and 117 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up .41% for the day; a total of 25.53 points. The current value is 6,288.3. Tesla, Inc. ( TSLA ) had the largest percent change down (-3.05%) while Micron Technology, Inc. ( MU ) had the largest percent change gain rising 3.37%.
The Dow Jones index closed up 1.14% for the day; a total of 260.37 points. The current value is 23,138.82. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change down (-.65%) while 3M Company ( MMM ) had the largest percent change gain rising 2.38%.
